name: UK Medical Records
description: UK hospital and GP records. Detects NHS numbers, UK dates (dd/mm/yyyy and long form), UK postcodes, UK phone numbers, National Insurance numbers, hospital numbers and patient names. Preserves lab values and clinical scores — numbers with decimals or commas are left untouched.

patterns.name: NHS Number
patterns.description: 10-digit NHS number, plain or in 3-3-4 format (e.g. 943 476 5919). Guarded so decimals and longer runs don't match.

patterns.name: MRN
patterns.description: Hospital number or MRN: 6 or more digits in a row with no digit, period or comma next to them (hospital numbers, local patient IDs). Lab values like 12.4 or 1,234.56 and short numbers stay visible.

patterns.name: Date
patterns.description: Full dates: day-first dd/mm/yyyy or dd-mm-yyyy, '5 January 1980' or '5th January 1980', and 'January 5, 1980', years 1900-2099.

patterns.name: Short date
patterns.description: Day-first date with a 2-digit year (e.g. 05/03/62). Off by default, turn it on for older records.

patterns.name: UK postcode
patterns.description: UK postcode, e.g. SW1A 1AA, M1 1AE, B33 8TH (case-sensitive).

patterns.name: NI number
patterns.description: National Insurance number, e.g. QQ 12 34 56 C or AB123456C.
